title: Requirements-document front-matter
description: The HTML-comment front-matter block at the top of a requirements document (context/<repo>/requirements/REQUIREMENTS.md, context/shared/requirements/REQUIREMENTS.md, or context/project/requirements/REQUIREMENTS.md). Keys are the <!-- key: value --> lines. Shape-only, like change-frontmatter.schema.json: it never validates the ### REQ-<NNN> body. See STANDARD-REQ.md.
